title: Repairs for Spalling Concrete, Ceiling and Sewage Pipe Leaks beyond Defects Liability Period
what_it_is: Repairs for Spalling Concrete, Ceiling and Sewage Pipe Leaks beyond Defects Liability Period

sections.label: HIP defects rectification and assistance
sections.summary: HDB contractors rectify defects reported within the one-year DLP; after DLP, HDB advises owners, and may co-share repair costs under the Goodwill Repair Assistance Scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For defects reported within the one-year Defects Liability Period (DLP) upon completion of the HIP works, the Housing and Development Board's (HDB's) contractors will carry out the necessary rectification.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For cases reported after DLP, HDB will look into the nature and cause of the feedback and advise flat owners on the follow-up action accordingly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: Over the past three years, the number of reported cases of defects due to workmanship of HIP works after the one-year DLP is small, of about one to two cases per 10,000 units per year for spalling concrete, ceiling and sewage pipe leaks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for National Development)
sentences.text: For ceiling leaks or spalling concrete cases that arise out of wear and tear, HDB may also offer assistance to flat owners to repair and co-share the cost of repairs under the Goodwill Repair Assistance Scheme.

sections.label: Absorbing repair costs and workmanship
sections.summary: A member asks if HDB can fully absorb repair costs for poor workmanship, and notes contractors fix workmanship-caused recurring leaks even after the DLP.

sentences.speaker: Mr Muhamad Faisal Bin Abdul Manap (Aljunied)
sentences.text: I just want to know whether HDB can consider absorbing fully the cost of such repairs, especially for problems that are observed to have resulted from poor workmanship or due to oversight during the pre-repair assessment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: But if workmanship is the cause of a leak recurring at the area where the repair works have been carried out, then even though it is after the DLP, if it is due to workmanship, the contractor will fix it.
